result.title: Two-Sided Conformal Evidence Sets for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
result.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026). 8 pages
result.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can surface passages that support a claim, contradict it, or fail to address it, yet existing calibrated grounding methods are typically one-sided and model only supporting evidence. We introduce Conformal Evidence Sets (CES), a two-sided framework that returns separate support and refutation sets with finite-sample inclusion coverage of at least $1-α$ on each side under exchangeability; a Bonferroni union yields joint coverage of at least $1-2α$. On labeled candidate pools from the contrastive VitaminC benchmark, CES closely tracks nominal coverage across $α\!\in\!\{0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30\}$, with maximum deviations of $3.0$ percentage points for support and $5.4$ for refutation, and reaches essentially the same empirical coverage--size frontier as a test-tuned fixed-threshold heuristic without any test exposure. Stress tests mark the boundary of that guarantee: under FEVER distribution shift both sides under-cover, by up to $12.7$ percentage points, and support-side group-stratified recalibration substantially reduces the support gap. Scorer swaps, hard-negative retrieval, cross-dataset transfer, and a live end-to-end pilot expose a clear separation: when exchangeability holds and relevant evidence is retrieved, evidence inclusion remains calibrated even with an imperfect scorer, whereas the support/refute verdict tracks scorer quality directly. Calibrated evidence coverage and reliable verdicts are therefore distinct properties and should be reported separately.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Conformal Evidence Sets，让 RAG 同时返回支持集与反驳集，并在可交换性下给出每侧至少 1−α 的有限样本覆盖保证；在 VitaminC、FEVER 等候选池上检验覆盖—规模前沿、分布偏移、打分器替换与端到端试点。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据覆盖可校准、判定可靠性另计」的分离结论与 conformal 证据集构造，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和「何时停止取证作答」提供可核查的校准工具，但纯文本 RAG 设定与视觉 latent 状态仍有距离。
